claims.quote: Type locality is the town of Luxian, located north of Luzhou city, Sichuan province, southwest China.

regions.name: Yangtze
regions.quote: Luxian lies on the Laixi River, one of several tributaries converging with the main Yangtze river channel near Luzhou and forming part of the latter's upper drainage basin.
